summary: 转换企业的边际利润和短期供给反应不仅取决于同日精矿与锂盐现货价，还取决于原料长协/包销的定价重置周期、在途与库存成本，以及锂盐客户合同的重定价时点；输入成本和成品实现价的不同vintage会让spot spread与真实当期margin暂时明显背离。
why_search_may_miss_it: 市场常用同期精矿与锂盐现货价计算加工价差，而长期包销、库存和客户合同各自的定价周期通常分散在合同或公司披露中。

recalled_details.gap_reason: CH-I005 establishes early feedstock contract lockups and CHC-011/G006 establish feed-mix conversion margins; this candidate refines them by making input-cost and product-price vintage mismatch an explicit time-axis semantic
recalled_details.replay_link: could explain why 2019-2020 converter operating decisions and reported margins lagged spot-price compression or recovery without inventing a new physical supply mechanism

锂精矿 长协 定价 重置 锂盐 合同 价格 滞后 加工利润
